sentences.en: The milk has been contaminated. It must be thrown out.
sentences.zh: 这牛奶被污染了，必须扔掉。

sentences.en: The water from that stream is contaminated with giardia.
sentences.zh: 那条溪流里的水被隐孢子虫污染了。

sentences.en: The water in this village is contaminated by arsenic.
sentences.zh: 这个村庄的水中含有砷，已经被污染了。

senses.zh: 弄脏，污染,损害，毒害vi.玷污，毒害，腐蚀（人的思想或品德）adj.〈古〉污染的
